title: Building depth no more than 20 m where single-aspect apartments line both sides of a central corridor
text: A 2.6.1 Developments that comprise single aspect apartments on each side of a central circulation corridor shall have a maximum building depth of 20m. All other proposals will be assessed on their merits with particular consideration to 4.1 Solar and daylight access and 4.2 Natural ventilation.
notes: Applies only to double-loaded single-aspect layouts (proposed fact building.single_aspect_central_corridor). Building depth measured per Figure 2.6b. The 20 m limit is unchanged while storey limits rise (C4P2-073). Volume 2 PG 2.6.7 not carried. Chapter 1 Table 3.5A row 'A2.6.1 Where decreasing building separation' is a cross-reference error: separation is A2.7.1; this clause is building depth (C4P2-007).
